race.comment: Ripping race dominated by debutants, a number of whom who have turned in some mighty impressive trials. One of those is ORGANISED CRIME (6), a brother to the former top colt King's Gambit who has not been knocked around in any of his hitouts. Was nominated for the 2YO race at Caulfield on Saturday, so the stable obviously rate him and he draws well here. AVENGERS (1) is one of only three who has been to the races and he'll find this more to his liking than the Sydney race he contested on debut, when not beaten far. BLUE IVY (8) didn't do a lot at her first trial but caught the eye at her latest when she beat home all bar the classy Angels Fury. She looked to have a fair bit in hand in that trial, too. LONG ISLAND OYSTER (5) showed them a clean pair of hooves at his latest jumpout at Caulfield and he drawn to give them something to catch.
